title: Mistress Kanan is Devilishly Easy
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kanan Takakiyo, head of her school's discipline committee, is secretly a demon who plans to devour the vital soul of junior Yoji Kyogi. He mistakes her threat for a confession, she accidentally becomes his girlfriend, and her romantic inexperience fuels running misunderstandings. A succubus maid, a clumsy angel named Jeanne and Kanan's demon family, headed by Beelzebub, join the comedy.
life_message: Love and devotion can overturn even a demon's appetites and win a family's acceptance.
